# Architecture Decision Records

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

This directory contains Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for `contentful/laravel`. Each ADR documents a significant decision: what was decided, why, and what trade-offs were accepted.

## Index

| ADR | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [001](./001-upstream-php-delivery-sdk.md) | Use `contentful/contentful` as the upstream PHP Delivery SDK | Accepted |
| [002](./002-deferred-service-provider.md) | Use a Deferred Service Provider | Accepted |
| [003](./003-php-82-minimum.md) | Require PHP 8.2+ (drop 8.0 and 8.1) | Accepted |
| [004](./004-integration-interface-telemetry.md) | Implement `IntegrationInterface` for Telemetry Tagging | Accepted |

## How to Add an ADR

1. Copy the template from `.claude/skills/seed-golden-context/templates/adr-template.md.tmpl` (or use the structure below)
2. Number it sequentially: `NNN-short-title.md`
3. Add it to the index table above
4. Reference it from `ARCHITECTURE.md` Key Dependencies or wherever relevant

```markdown
# ADR-NNN: Title

## Status
Accepted | Superseded by ADR-NNN | Deprecated

## Context
What problem or decision was faced?

## Decision
What was chosen and why?

## Consequences
Trade-offs accepted. What this enables or prevents.
```
